name: OpenAPI REST
description: OpenAPI support for the REST module.
project_description:
Integrates with the base Open API module to generate the definitions for core REST. If you want documentation of your core REST powered API, you need to enable this module and a documentation generator like Open API UI ReDoc . Check out the Open API project for more information about alternative UI generators.

 
 This module requires Open API 2.x or above. 
 This module does provides the necessary plugins for the Open API to serve the JSON:API definition document. For that it needs at least Open API (8.x-2.x) .

 
 Back to top 

 Version notes 
 The version 2.x of this Drupal module implements version 2 of the Open API specification.

 On the other hand, version 3.x of this Drupal module implements version 3 (latest and better supported) of the Open API specification .
